doc.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022

chapter: Working with Al Grey and Diva
title: The all-female big band Diva
summary: Diva has lasted over thirty years, brought in international players, and built friendships and experience for women.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: We’re talk — let’s talk about Diva for a minute. I know Sherrie and it’s been quite an amazing project.

Twenty-five — let me see — it’s over thirty years I think by now. It’s been a really important band. I think it brought a number of people in from other countries that were able to get Visas because of it, and it’s given a lot of women experience that they wouldn’t have gotten otherwise, and created a lot of long term friendships. A lot of people have come through that band.
